title: Understand Forwarder, Heavy Forwarder, and Indexer Processing
objectives: Understand Forwarder, Heavy Forwarder, and Indexer Processing
Verify the active operational state and explain the evidence.

tasks.instruction: On idx01 create pipeline_logs. Configure hf01 outputs.conf to forward to idx01:9997, then restart hf01. Monitor /var/log/practice/pipeline.log on hf01 into pipeline_logs. The file contains one explicit record.

Verify delivery on idx01 and identify the first full parsing tier. Universal forwarders collect and forward; this bounded path applies props/transforms at the first heavy forwarder, otherwise the indexer.

hints: Inspect effective configuration and the delivery error before changing a setting.
Creating an index does not add events. Verify the destination, activation and search window independently.

checks.label: pipeline_logs is active on idx01 with the required settings
checks.name: pipeline_logs

checks.label: Search independently confirms the indexed result
checks.search: index=pipeline_logs source="/var/log/practice/pipeline.log" | stats count by splunk_server

questions.prompt: Which component role is the first parsing tier on this path?

feedback.success: Completion requires active configuration, verified search results and correct evidence answers.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect failed outcomes. Disk changes require activation; data must be ingested explicitly.
